input_status: Exploratory reuse of the already-published64curve/8192publictarget panel. No fresh confirmation sample, new private entropy or target labels.

setting_law.seed: Exact existing public solver_cell seed; paired across all variants and all native families.
setting_law.rho: Run once per originalfixture/rep with original default t and cap4; data remain one actual reference execution, never copied/padded native rows.

primary_metric.definition: Disjoint fixture_validation.counters.group_additions + setup.counters.group_additions + sum target0..63.counters.group_additions; includes common native fixture/target subgroup certification, setup, solve, public answer and endpoint checks.
primary_metric.phase_disjointness_source: Native run() constructs a separate validation Ops, then a fresh Table-owned Ops; each target emits after-minus-before delta. No nested scalar/doubling diagnostic is added.

prefix_scope: Only setup+target costs at prefixes; upfront input validation charged only to full64Q total, never prorated.
comparisons: Report all8 harvest/static_small settings, static_full/static_filled/sharedrho context and all8 exact static_small/harvest_disabled A/A. Keep completegrid/globalbeststatic context, no selectively favorablebaseline or posthoc confirmatorywinner.

bootstrap.unit: curve, preserving bothreplicates, allvariants/sharedreference correlations and nestedprefixes
bootstrap.scope: Exploratory, no familywise discovery/selection-adjusted confirmation claim.

incomplete_policy: Retain all attempted/failed/censored/unattempted/unknown-spawn outcomes. Any missing/censored/invalid target in the64curve/two-replicate pairedcontrast makes that variant comparison undefined; no success-only dropping or zero-cost substitution.
clock_policy: Record actual whole-child wait4CPU/wall/RSS; all clocks wall_valid=false and no qualified runtime or exclusivehost/L2 inference.
review_policy: The bounded counter/scope round below may run in parallel. It does not block this new exploratory measurement; qualified advantage or scientific promotion awaits appropriate completed evidence/review.
